Name: Family Mailbox
Author: Miricancan
Description:
[heading]Family Mailbox｜家庭邮箱[/heading]
[b]English[/b]
This mod adds a Family Mailbox that lets you send items to your parents. You may receive a letter—or even a gift—in return!
The Family Mailbox is located beside the Bus Stop. Hold the item you wish to send and interact with the mailbox to mail it. Replies from your parents will be delivered to the original mailbox beside your farmhouse.
[line]
[b]中文[/b]
这个模组为游戏添加了一个家庭邮箱，允许你给父母寄送物品。你可能会收到父母的回信，甚至是他们寄来的礼物！
邮箱位于巴士站旁。手持想要寄出的物品与邮箱交互，即可将其寄给父母。父母的回信会送到农舍旁的原版邮箱中。

[heading]Installation｜安装方法[/heading]
[b]English[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download and unzip the mod.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]FamilyMailbox[/code]folder in your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
